items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: And most of the other boys, like Hershel Evans and Dick Wilson and Lester Young and all of them out there, they were out West -- they had their own style.

ctx.x: Later on they had a guy who died, who drank a lot. A very good player. I can't remember his name. Anyway...
Oh, you're talking about Dick Wilson.
